## Subsystem
Bot / engine / web / mesh / tests / hosting — which one?

## What and why
What are you building or fixing, and why does it matter?

## Smallest shippable step
The smallest change that can be verified independently.

## Conservation / safety impact
Does this touch Dots, pockets, identity, or matching? If yes, say how it stays
safe (fail-closed, synthetic data, aggregate-only).

## Verification
How will we know it works? (tests, demo, Mesh Lab, etc.)
